module: Computes spherical exclusion zones for AI traffic along the rally special stages, then applies them to the navgraph (`map.setTrafficExclusionZones` + `map.reset`) so that traffic does not drive on the course. The zones come from the driveline (drivelineV3) of each `rallyStage` mission, sampled every 1.5 x radius, and, for a loop, from an optional `trafficGatedRoads.grzones.json` file in the mission folder. Default radius: 10 m.
notes: Only missions of type `rallyStage` produce zones; the other types give an "Unsupported mission type" warning. Road sections (rallyRoadSection) found via extractMissionIdsFromRallyLoop are therefore ignored when creating the zones.
If no mission is given to createZones, the rally editor's current mission (editor_rallyEditor.getMissionId) is used.
applyForRallyLoop and clearTrafficExclusion call map.reset(), which reloads the navgraph: an expensive operation.
The functions loadRacePath, createZonesForRallyStage and applyForMissionIds are dead code (commented out or unused local).

createZones.desc: Builds the list of exclusion zones for rally missions. For each `rallyStage` mission, loads the driveline and samples its points every 1.5 x radius.

missions.desc: Missions (gameplay_missions_missions objects). If empty or nil, uses the rally editor's mission.

radius.desc: Radius of the zones in meters; default 10.

returns.desc: List of {pos = vec3, radius = number}; empty if nothing is available.

extractMissionIdsFromRallyLoop.desc: Reads mission.fgVariables of a loop mission and returns the ids of the missions used, in order: for each stage 1 to 4, the road section (`stageN_rallyRoadSection`) then the special stage (`stageN_rallyStage`), finally `return_rallyRoadSection`. The values have the format "Name (id)"; `<none>` is ignored.

returns.desc: Mission ids; empty if fgVariables is absent.

applyForRallyLoop.desc: Applies the traffic exclusion for a loop: finds the missions via extractMissionIdsFromRallyLoop, creates the zones, adds the spheres of the optional trafficGatedRoads.grzones.json file (spheres field with pos {x,y,z} and radius), then calls map.setTrafficExclusionZones and map.reset().

radius.desc: Radius of the zones coming from the special stages; default 10.

returns.desc: Applied zones ({pos, radius}); empty table if loopMission is nil.

clearTrafficExclusion.desc: Removes all the exclusion zones (map.clearTrafficExclusionZones) and reloads the navgraph (map.reset).

getDefaultRadius.desc: Returns the default radius of the zones.
